title: 第一卷 南域篇 第17章 断剑名藏锋第一卷 南域篇 第18章 雷雨夜惊魂
slug: 剑问九州第1286章星域虫潮
content_zh:
“他娘的，差点让那畜生玩死。”欧阳木骂骂咧咧地瘫坐在地上，从怀里摸出三枚灵元果，丢给白泽，“还好有灵药，吃了，恢复一下！”
白泽接了过来，两枚封进棋子，抓起其中一颗，掰开，将火红的果肉和汁水一股脑吞进喉咙。
欧阳木注意到白泽手腕上棋子串成的手链，没有多说，也剥了一枚灵元果，吞了下去，调息运作。
果肉入体，白泽顿觉一股暖流流经心肺，汇向腹部丹田。
他闭目行周天运转。
附近灵气浓郁，白泽默念纯阳心法，练气入体。同时，丹田气海自行运转，辅助炼化灵元果温润的能量。
如果说纯阳练气，灵气如丝如缕，那么灵元果的能量就好像涓涓细流。
白泽尽力做到不浪费一丝一毫，牵引纯净的能量周行全身，最后炼化为纯阳真气，汇入丹田气海。
原本透骨阴寒的身体，在灵元果的温润下，逐渐恢复温暖。随后，白泽察觉到身体逐渐发烫，有什么东西正一点一点透出皮肤，仿佛出汗。
白泽心知肚明，那是他身体的杂质。灵元果淬体的功效，由此可见一斑。
两人都静坐调息，正午时分，先后睁开双眼，疲惫的身体已经恢复六七。
“这玩意果然奇效！”欧阳木闻着身上散发出来的缕缕臭味，感叹，“难怪道门那些老牛鼻子，整天钻进深山老林，采药炼丹。寻常灵药已经这么神异，练成仙丹，岂不是功效翻倍？”
两人当下清理身体，收拾妥当，在洞口附近捡了些能用的枯树枝，做成火把，准备进洞一探。
“方才运气，察觉这里灵气浓郁，灵石一事，或许是真的。”白泽体内的气海又大了一圈。
欧阳木点头，点燃火把，“我也察觉到了。事到如今，我们也只能进去一探，如果果真有灵石，也不枉我们这么舍生忘死来这一遭。”
山洞内部极黑，好在有火把照明，也不至于盲人摸象。两人走了片刻，空间倒是愈发开阔起来，一举一动，皆有诡异的回声。
“这鸟地方这么大？”欧阳木说，“看来是矿洞无疑了。”说着，又担心起来，“你说，百年前那些人把这地方挖这么大，灵石会不会已经被挖空了啊？”
“这谁知道？”白泽心里也犯嘀咕。
就在这时，山洞忽然狭窄起来，伸手就能摸着洞顶。
可也就在这时，山洞前方，忽然出现若有若无的闪光！

“有光！”两人同时叫了出来，那光不是阳光，而更像是某种晶体折射火光散发出来的闪光。
灵石？这是两人的第一反应。可等两人钻进那更大的洞窟，才颓然发现，那不是灵石，而是水晶。
各种颜色的水晶，赤橙黄绿青蓝紫，在火光的照耀下熠熠生辉，将整个庞大的洞窟映得五光十色，人在其中，仿佛身在无尽宇宙，环绕身边的，是浩瀚星光。
“这水晶虽然也值钱，可与灵石相比，可就差远了。”欧阳木有些沮丧，一屁股坐在地上。
“你等我看看。”白泽心念一动，忽然想起谢玄传授他的气运山河。这门道术他虽然不能完美运用，可用来探寻此地是否有灵石矿脉，还不简单？
“你有什么办法？”欧阳木一听，勉强打起精神。
“静观便知。”白泽卖了个关子，暗运心法，掐了个道诀，暗道：“天地无极，乾坤借法！气运山河！”
“嗡！——”
真气调动，白泽顿见条条地脉纵横身周，普通置身无尽罗网之中。
不看不知道，一看吓一跳。洞窟之中，强横的灵气纵横交错，历经百年仍保持形态，不死不灭。
“这是……高手战斗过留下的灵气波动？”白泽震惊，眼前除了山脉之灵交织，还有真气行过留下的灵气刻痕。
那些痕迹和地脉的流动不同，它们都是死去的模样，固定不动。
白泽一眼看去，那些凝固的灵气，如刀如枪，至今仍散发着惊人的杀机！
“什么？”欧阳木追问。
白泽来不及解释，因为他真的看见了灵石矿脉。只是可惜，那矿脉深入山脉地底，非他二人能开采的。
那灵石矿脉如巨龙横江，白泽一眼看去，仿佛雾里看花，虽不真切，可那浓郁浑厚的灵气，绝非一般地方可比！
难怪这里能碰见剧情中期成年后能横推一众强者的牛鬼幼体，恐怕那寒潭之中，也是别有洞天。
白泽心里一动，去看寒潭所在的方向，却是一片漆黑，什么也看不见。
“到底有没有灵石？”欧阳木耐不住性子又问。
“有！”白泽点头，回过神来，那寒潭的玄机，不是他此刻能够窥探的。

“在哪？”欧阳木大喜过望，爬了起来，撸起袖子就要去挖。
“地底数百丈，我二人要挖，非累死不可。”白泽说。
欧阳木瞪大双眼，半晌，骂了一声，“那还挖个屁！”
content_en:
"Damn it, I almost let that beast play to death." Ouyang Mu cursed and collapsed on the ground. He took out three Lingyuan Fruits from his arms and threw them to Bai Ze. "Fortunately, there is a magic medicine. Take it and recover!"
Bai Ze took it, sealed two pieces into the chess pieces, grabbed one of them, broke it open, and swallowed the red pulp and juice into his throat.
Ouyang Mu noticed the bracelet made of chess pieces on Bai Ze's wrist. Without saying anything, he peeled off a Lingyuan fruit, swallowed it, and adjusted his breathing.
After the fruit pulp enters the body, Baize suddenly feels a warm current flowing through the heart and lungs, converging towards the Dantian in the abdomen.
He closed his eyes and moved around.
There was strong spiritual energy nearby, so Bai Ze silently recited the Pure Yang Heart Method and practiced the energy into his body. At the same time, the sea of ​​Qi in Dantian circulates on its own, assisting in refining the warm energy of Lingyuan Fruit.
If pure Yang Qi is practiced, the spiritual energy is like a thread, then the energy of the Lingyuan Fruit is like a trickle.
Bai Ze tried his best not to waste any of it, drawing pure energy to circulate throughout the body, and finally refined it into pure Yang Qi, and merged into the Dantian Qi sea.
The body that was originally cold to the bone gradually regained its warmth under the warmth of the Lingyuan Fruit. Later, Bai Ze noticed that his body was gradually getting hot, and something was leaking out of his skin bit by bit, as if he was sweating.
Bai Ze knew very well that those were impurities in his body. The effect of Lingyuan Fruit in tempering the body can be seen from this.
Both of them sat quietly and adjusted their breath. At noon, they opened their eyes one after another, and their exhausted bodies had already recovered.
"This thing is indeed miraculous!" Ouyang Mu sighed as he smelled the stench emanating from his body, "No wonder those old men from the Taoist sect spend their days going deep into the mountains and forests to collect herbs and make elixirs. Ordinary elixirs are already so miraculous. If they are made into elixirs, wouldn't their effectiveness be doubled?"
The two immediately cleaned up and packed up, picked up some useful dead branches near the entrance of the cave, made them into torches, and prepared to go into the cave to explore.
"Just by luck, I noticed that the spiritual energy here is rich, and the spiritual stone may be true." The sea of ​​energy in Bai Ze's body grew larger again.
Ouyang Mu nodded and lit the torch, "I noticed it too. At this point, we can only go in and have a look. If there is indeed a spiritual stone, it will not be in vain for us to risk our lives to come here."
The inside of the cave is extremely dark, but fortunately there are torches for illumination, so it is not like a blind man trying to figure out an elephant. The two walked for a while, and the space became wider and wider, and there were strange echoes in every move.
"Is this place so big?" Ouyang Mu said, "It seems to be a mine without a doubt." As he said that, he became worried again, "Tell me, if those people dug this place so big a hundred years ago, would the spirit stone have been hollowed out?"
"Who knows?" Bai Ze also muttered in his heart.
At this moment, the cave suddenly became narrow, and you could reach out and touch the top of the cave.
But at this moment, a faint flash of light suddenly appeared in front of the cave!
"There is light!" The two of them shouted at the same time. The light was not sunlight, but more like the flash of light refracted by some kind of crystal.
Spiritual stone? This was the first reaction of the two people. But when the two of them got into the larger cave, they discovered that it was not a spiritual stone, but a crystal.
Crystals of various colors, red, orange, yellow, green, blue and violet, sparkle under the firelight, making the entire huge cave colorful. People in it feel as if they are in an endless universe, surrounded by vast starlight.
"Although this crystal is valuable, it is far behind compared to the spirit stone." Ouyang Mu was a little frustrated and sat down on the ground.
"Wait for me and see." Bai Ze thought, and suddenly remembered the Qi Luck taught to him by Xie Xuan. Although he can't use this Taoist skill perfectly, it can be used to explore whether there are spirit stone veins here. Isn't it simple?
"What can you do?" Ouyang Mu reluctantly cheered up after hearing this.
"You'll know if you just wait and see." Bai Ze took advantage of the situation, secretly used his inner skills, and secretly said: "The heaven and earth are infinite, and the universe borrows the law! Qi transports mountains and rivers!"
"Buzz!——"
Mobilizing the true energy, Bai Ze suddenly sees the situationThere are earth veins crisscrossing the body, and one is usually trapped in an endless net.
You won’t know if you don’t look at it, but you will be shocked when you look at it. In the cave, tyrannical auras crisscrossed each other, and they remained immortal after hundreds of years.
"This is...the spiritual energy fluctuation left by the master's battle?" Bai Ze was shocked. In addition to the interweaving of the mountain spirits, there were also spiritual energy marks left by the passage of true energy.
Those traces are different from the flow of earth veins. They are dead and fixed.
At a glance, Bai Ze saw that those solidified auras, like knives and spears, still exuded astonishing murderous intent!
"What?" Ouyang Mu asked.
Bai Ze had no time to explain, because he really saw the spirit stone vein. It's just a pity that the ore veins go deep into the mountains and cannot be mined by the two of them.
The spirit stone veins were like giant dragons crossing the river. At a glance, Bai Ze felt like he was looking at flowers in the mist. Although it was not realistic, the rich and powerful spiritual energy was definitely not comparable to ordinary places!
No wonder you can meet the ox-ghost larvae here in the middle of the plot, which can overwhelm all the strong men when they become adults. I am afraid that there is a unique cave in the cold pool.
Bai Ze's heart moved and he looked in the direction of Hantan, but it was completely dark and he couldn't see anything.
"Are there any spiritual stones?" Ouyang Mu asked impatiently.
"Yes!" Bai Ze nodded and came back to his senses. The mystery of Hantan was not something he could pry into at this moment.
"Where is it?" Ouyang Mu was overjoyed, climbed up, rolled up his sleeves and was about to dig.
"There are hundreds of feet of ground underground, and the two of us have to dig to death." Bai Ze said.
Ouyang Mu's eyes widened, and after a while, he cursed, "What a waste!"
